replacements.before: ## Short windows tighten the spacing, then shrink the logo (88..150) so the logo and footer fit

reason: The three native errors come from `play_button.grab_focus.call_deferred()` running after the router has already done `remove_child(current)` (immediate Enter → `_replace`, and the synchronous Preferences 1.3→1.0 path → `_on_preferences_changed` → `show_title` twice). `remove_child` takes the Title out of the tree at once, but `queue_free` only frees it after the deferred-call flush. So the stale deferred `grab_focus` still runs on a live, out-of-tree Button and hits the `!is_inside_tree()` condition in `control.cpp`. The patch defers a Title method that checks `is_inside_tree()` and `play_button.is_visible_in_tree()` before grabbing focus. A replaced Title therefore does nothing and cannot take focus from the new screen. If the Title were already freed, the deferred Callable's object would be invalid and the message queue would drop it. The live Title keeps the same timing as before (one deferred grab_focus). That preserves `focus_entered` → `_on_next_frame(_show_logo_with_play)`, follow_focus scrolling, Tab/Enter, and the Settings return path (`panel_closed` → `settings_button.grab_focus`). `_fit_to_viewport`, `_show_logo_with_play`, `_on_next_frame`, the one-shot `process_frame` connections, and all v3 geometry constants are byte-unchanged. No Menu, router, theme, font, text, color, hierarchy or engine changes.
